attachments.origin_landmark: long head: infraglenoid tubercle; lateral head: posterior humerus, proximal to spiral groove (humerus_r); medial head: posterior humerus, distal to spiral groove (humerus_r)

actions: extends and adducts shoulder (long head only)

functional_compartments.name: Long head
functional_compartments.innervation_branch: radial n., branch to long head (proximal)
functional_compartments.function_note: Only head crossing the shoulder; contributes to shoulder extension/adduction as well as elbow extension.
functional_compartments.source: Holzbaur KR, Murray WM, Delp SL (2005) Ann Biomed Eng 33(6):829-840 -- upper-extremity musculoskeletal model; Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell)

functional_compartments.name: Lateral head
functional_compartments.innervation_branch: radial n., branch to lateral head (proximal, above spiral groove)
functional_compartments.function_note: Superficial, strongest elbow-extension moment arm of the three heads.
functional_compartments.source: Holzbaur KR, Murray WM, Delp SL (2005) Ann Biomed Eng 33(6):829-840 -- upper-extremity musculoskeletal model; Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell)

functional_compartments.name: Medial head, superficial subregion
functional_compartments.innervation_branch: radial n., branch to medial head (distal, below spiral groove)
functional_compartments.function_note: Deep to long/lateral heads; active across the full range of elbow extension including low-force postural tasks (documented 'workhorse' recruitment pattern).
functional_compartments.source: Holzbaur KR, Murray WM, Delp SL (2005) Ann Biomed Eng 33(6):829-840 -- upper-extremity musculoskeletal model; Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); architecture note consistent with described deep/superficial subdivision of the medial head in cadaveric dissection studies

functional_compartments.name: Medial head, deep subregion (adjacent to elbow joint capsule)
functional_compartments.innervation_branch: radial n., distal terminal twigs to medial head (continues as ulnar collateral/articular branch)
functional_compartments.function_note: Fibers blending into the posterior elbow joint capsule (articularis cubiti-like function), tensing the capsule during extension to prevent impingement.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell) (describes deepest medial-head fibers inserting into the posterior joint capsule)

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998); Holzbaur KR, Murray WM, Delp SL (2005) Ann Biomed Eng 33(6):829-840 -- upper-extremity musculoskeletal model
